result_text:
The `reports` module builds and its tests pass offline (`mvn -q -o -pl reports test`, exit code 0).

The fix is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` names in `all_files.zip` are replaced by a small helper, `getAspectTextEntry`, which names each entry with the same `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")` call the loose files use. The order is unchanged. Because the failure happened in the same `try` block, `git-history.zip` was also skipped; it should now be written again.

I did not run an export with a renamed aspect. The expectation that `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` appears is based on reading the naming code, not on a run. Nothing is committed.
